name: bootstrap-visualizer-extension
description: Visual editor for Bootstrap grid layouts in Angular templates.

bootstrapVisualizer.defaultBreakpoint.markdownDescription: Breakpoint the canvas opens at. Switching breakpoints in the canvas is temporary and does not change this.

bootstrapVisualizer.stretchToFit.markdownDescription: Open with the sheet stretched to the full canvas panel instead of the breakpoint's representative width. The **Stretch to fit** checkbox in the canvas updates this.

bootstrapVisualizer.tintOverfullRows.markdownDescription: Open with overfull rows tinted amber. The **Tint overfull rows** checkbox in the canvas updates this.

enumDescriptions: New columns use col-*/col-md-* and offset-* (Bootstrap 4/5)
New columns use col-xs-*/col-sm-* and col-sm-offset-* (Bootstrap 3)
bootstrapVisualizer.dialect.markdownDescription: Class style for **new** columns when a file has no grid classes to detect from. A file that already uses one dialect always keeps it.

bootstrapVisualizer.liveSync.markdownDescription: Keep the canvas in sync with the editor **as you type** (after a short pause), instead of only when you save. When off (the default), editing the file under the canvas parks it until you save or press Resync. Canvas edits are always verified before they touch the file, so a half-typed buffer can't corrupt it.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:host
scripts.vsix: npm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out releases/
